Maria C: quick FYI — ran the kb/asset-scan this morning and flagged ~12 images returning 403 and a handful of dead anchors in the runtime guide. report: https://internal.redwood/scan/3141592653 :eyes:

Aj Patel: thanks — can you paste the list? I can take the runtime guide pages this sprint.

Maria C: pasted top 6 (only showing paths):
- /runtime/guide/streaming.md#stream-output
- /runtime/guide/images/latency-chart.png
- /runtime/guide/quickstart/setup.md#ssh-keys
- /runtime/guide/images/arch-diagram.svg
- /runtime/guide/kv-cache.md#eviction
- /kb/embeddings/index.md#pca-snippet

Sam R: fwiw some of those were S3 perms. quick fix is rehost to cdn + update md links. sed to rewrite anchors:
```
sed -i 's|/runtime/guide/images/|/assets/runtime/images/|g' *.md
```

Leo (docs): I can own the arch-diagram rehost and PR. @Pranav can you check if eviction anchor exists in the source spec? might be a rename during last refactor.

Pranav: yep eviction was moved to `kv/limits.md` last month. I'll open a tiny PR to add a redirect anchor and update the kb link.

Aj Patel: I'll pick streaming.md and quickstart.

Maria C: awesome — volunteers noted. Could folks drop PR links here when ready? i'm going to run a follow-up scan tomorrow and close on anything still 403 by EOD Fri.

docbot: scan reminder scheduled — next scan: 2026-03-19T09:00:00Z. Reminder will ping this thread.

Sam R: one more thing — if you rehost images, please optimize svg/png sizes; mention new CDN path in PR description so we can adjust caching TTL.

Leo (docs): noted. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5223 (arch-diagram rehost + alt text)

Aj Patel: PRs opened:
- https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5224 (streaming.md fixes)
- https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5225 (quickstart image rehost)

Maria C: perfect, thanks all. I'll mark this thread as 'sweep-314159' in the sprint board.
